Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_Maximum: Aim-time multiplier at the firearm's physical maximum range. Effective-sight range remains at normal speed. Default: 4.0.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_CurveEx: Controls how quickly extra aim time ramps up beyond effective-sight range. Higher values keep the increase gentler near sight range and steeper near maximum range. Default: 1.5.
